articles.headline: Dani Alves to pay Pumas $2.25M after CAS ruling upheld
articles.description: Former Barcelona star Dani Alves will have to pay Liga MX's Pumas UNAM $2.25 million in compensation after a Swiss court ratified the ruling made by the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS).

articles.headline: MLS' Leagues Cup implosion reveals how much work league has left to do
articles.description: After the World Cup, MLS ran an ad that read: "We'll take it from here." In its made-up Leagues Cup, though, the only thing it has taken is an L.
